resources.string: This MVP is not ready for real sensitive conversations. Its libsignal-based protocol integration has not had an independent security review.
No phone number and no address book upload. A cryptographic identity will be created only for this device.
A copied code can stay in the clipboard or keyboard history (the Samsung keyboard keeps it). Showing the QR code in person, or Share, is safer.
Scan a secure invitation QR code
Development delivery endpoint for this device. For a physical phone on the same Wi-Fi network, enter the laptop LAN address.
Emulator LAN default: http://10.0.2.2:8787. Physical LAN example: http://192.168.1.45:8787. Public tunnel example: https://example-relay.example.
HTTP relay is permitted only in this debug build for local Wi-Fi testing. It does not protect network metadata or transport integrity.
Insecure HTTP relay is blocked in release builds. Enter an HTTPS relay URL.

On a physical phone, 127.0.0.1 and localhost point to the phone itself, not your laptop. Use the laptop Wi-Fi address, for example http://192.168.0.87:8787, or keep 127.0.0.1 only over a USB cable with adb reverse tcp:8787 tcp:8787.
0.0.0.0 is valid for a server listening on all interfaces, but it is not a client address. On a physical phone, use the laptop Wi-Fi address, for example http://192.168.0.87:8787.
Public relay / tunnel mode uses an HTTPS URL that both the phone and emulator can reach.
HTTP is allowed only for debug LAN testing.
For tests across different networks, use an HTTPS relay URL.
Background synchronization is best effort and may be delayed by Android power management.
This action deletes the local profile, messages, contacts, and protocol keys from this device. The data cannot be recovered.
Debug-only test reset deletes the local profile, contacts, messages, invitations, and all protocol keys and sessions. The saved Relay URL is kept for repeated LAN testing.

This is a destructive debug action. It permanently deletes the local test profile, messages, contacts, invitations, protocol keys, sessions and pending delivery from this device. The saved Relay URL remains. Continue only when you intend to restart the test.
Test build of the new end-to-end protocol. Not independently reviewed; do not use for real conversations.
Show this code to the person you want to chat with. It can be used once and expires in 24 hours. Anyone who photographs it can send you a request, so check the safety number before you accept.
Compare these digits with your contact in person or over another trusted channel. If they differ, do not continue.
No contacts in protocol v2 yet.
Waiting for the other person to accept
This invitation code is not valid.
This invitation uses an unsupported version.
The invitation was not found on the relay. Ask for a new one.
This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
Request sent. Waiting for the other person to accept.
The relay could not be reached.
Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
Sending is blocked for this contact.

While this screen is open, messages are fetched every few seconds. Otherwise background sync runs when Android allows it (about every 15 minutes or later); it is best effort, not a delivery guarantee.
This build is not for messaging
Chats are available only in test (debug) builds until the new protocol has had an independent security review. This build does not send or receive messages.

This version replaced the old prototype protocol with the new end-to-end protocol. Old test chats, contacts, and their keys were deleted on purpose and cannot be restored or reused. Pair with your contacts again using a new invitation.
Data on this phone cannot be read

The key that protects your conversations on this phone is missing or no longer matches them. This can happen after the key storage of the phone was reset. The messages, contacts and keys stored here cannot be decrypted again, and nothing was sent or received without the key. To use the app again, delete the local data and create a new profile. Your contacts will need a new invitation from you and will see a new safety number.
Data is not available right now
The secure key storage of the phone or the local database did not respond. Nothing was deleted. Check again; if this keeps happening, restart the phone.
Delete local data and start over

The delivery server now protects each inbox with a secret, so only its owner can read or delete waiting messages. Old test chats could not move to the new inboxes and were deleted on purpose; your profile stays. Pair with your contacts again using a new invitation.
Did you get the file I sent yesterday?
I will call you around noon.
